findings.title: Better Auth Configuration Duplication Still Present
findings.description: Codebase has two Better Auth config files (lib/auth/server.ts without bearer plugin, lib/auth-config.ts with bearer plugin). Design specifies modifying only lib/auth/server.ts but doesn't address bearer plugin needed for mobile.
findings.fix: Option A (preferred): Consolidate to lib/auth/server.ts with bearer plugin, make lib/auth-config.ts a re-export. Option B: Update both files with Google provider.

findings.fix: Add import at top of file: import { sql } from 'drizzle-orm';
